title: CBOR 協議
content:
For high-performance, binary-optimized APIs, Photon supports CBOR (Concise Binary Object Representation). This is ideal for IoT devices or microservices where payload size is critical.

The Binary Middleware

Instead of manually encoding data, you can use the binaryMiddleware. It automatically intercepts JSON responses and encodes them into CBOR if the client specifies Accept: application/cbor.

import { binaryMiddleware } from '@gravito/photon/middleware/binary'

// Apply globally or to specific routes
app.use(binaryMiddleware())

app.get('/api/data', (c) => {
  // If client wants CBOR, this becomes binary automatically!
  return c.json({ id: 101, status: 'operational' })
})

Why CBOR?

  • Small Size: Typically 30-50% smaller than JSON.
  • No Parsing Overhead: Binary structures are faster to navigate than text-based JSON.
  • Standardized: Part of the IETF RFC 7049 standard.
